name: Nahyndrian Focus
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-17: The Devil in the Details
description: A metal lattice forged from warshards feeds into a dark purplish crystal that pulses with energy. If the configuration of the lattice changes, so does the energy the device emits.
disable: Three Disable device dc=27 (see Disabling the Focus under Event 1 on page 18).
routine: (3 actions) The Nahyndrian Focus uses Select Condition to determine which condition it is going to inflict. It then uses Inflict twice, usually on two different targets. If the focus is broken, it is Slowed 1, and can only Inflict once per turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Offensive Configuration
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Yollen activates the Nahyndrian Focus

Effect The Nahyndrian Focus shifts into attack mode and rolls initiative. All creatures without the unholy trait in within 60 feet must make a Basic DC 31 Fortitude Saving Throw save against (4d10+22) Spirit Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Select Condition
offensiveAbilities.description: The Nahyndrian Focus rolls a 1d4 #condition to randomly decide whether it is going cause the Clumsy, Drained, Enfeebled, or Stupefied condition when it uses Inflict until the end of its turn. After the first round, it changes the random roll die to 1d6 #condition as it does not pick the same condition it had in the previous round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Inflict
offensiveAbilities.description:
An unhealthy beam shoots out from the focus. One creature without the unholy trait within 60 feet of the Focus must make a DC 31 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The target becomes immune to Inflict for 1 minute.

Success The targe gains the condition from Select Condition with a value of 1 for 1 minute.

Failure As success, but with a value of 2.

Critical Failure As success, but with a value of 3.
